requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: The HP Magellan printer must support NGB keyed bottles with 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, and bottle size for CMY greater than 8K.
requirements.Rationale: To enable high-volume printing and ensure compatibility with new bottle designs for improved user experience and operational efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink system design, IDS startup algorithm, tank size optimization
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer accepts NGB keyed bottles, achieves 6K Black and 6K CMY page yields, and supports larger CMY bottle sizes (>8K).

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: The ink bottle system must provide spill-free reliability to prevent ink leakage during installation and operation.
requirements.Rationale: To minimize customer complaints, reduce warranty claims, and improve overall user satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: Keyed bottle design, IDS connection, NOA-F implementation
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink bottle installation and removal processes do not result in any ink spills under normal operating conditions.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: The NOA-F (New Output Assembly - Filter) must feature a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, with no change to click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and maintain compatibility with existing assembly mechanisms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F is produced with metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, and is compatible with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Reuse Superamp Si PHA
requirements.Description: The Magellan printer must reuse Superamp Si PHA (Printhead Assembly) from previous platforms to leverage proven technology and reduce development costs.
requirements.Rationale: To increase reliability, speed up time-to-market, and reduce investment costs by reusing existing components.
requirements.Dependencies: Superamp Si PHA compatibility, ink system integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Superamp Si PHA is integrated and functions as required in the Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: Reuse Magi / Nessie Ink without Reformulation
requirements.Description: The Magellan printer must reuse Magi and Nessie pigment inks without requiring reformulation.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain ink performance and reduce R&D costs by leveraging existing ink formulations.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink compatibility, IDS startup algorithm, tank design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer uses Magi and Nessie inks as-is, with no reformulation required.

requirements.Title: Reliability Characterization and Modelling
requirements.Description: The printer must undergo reliability, WVTR (Water Vapor Transmission Rate), air gain, flow rate, and IDS characterization and modelling, including startup and NOA-F EOL (End of Life).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure robust operation and longevity of the printer and its components.
requirements.Dependencies: IDS design, NOA-F implementation, ink system
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reliability modelling completed, results meet defined thresholds for WVTR, air gain, flow rate, and IDS performance at startup and NOA-F EOL.

requirements.Title: Ink Stability Modelling for Tank Impact to PQ
requirements.Description: Ink stability must be modelled to assess impact on print quality (PQ) and tank performance.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent print quality and ink longevity under various operating conditions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink stability modelling is performed and shows negligible impact on PQ for specified tank configurations.

requirements.Title: NOA-F as Service Parts in Warranty Support
requirements.Description: NOA-F must be available as service parts for warranty support, ensuring easy replacement and maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: To provide ongoing warranty support and reduce service downtime for customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: Service Teams, Warranty Management, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F parts are stocked and available for warranty service within defined lead times.

requirements.Title: Acumen 6 on Lid
requirements.Description: The printer lid must incorporate Acumen 6 technology for enhanced operational tracking and diagnostics.
requirements.Rationale: To improve serviceability and enable advanced diagnostics for maintenance and troubleshooting.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Acumen 6 is integrated and operational on the printer lid.

requirements.Title: Factory Configuration for NOA-F and Ink Cart
requirements.Description: Modify existing SA14 production line for NOA-F, add Magi ink cartridge and labelling tool in Orcus 5, and ensure PHA + Dry FI + USG + push-push are assembled in printer factory.
requirements.Rationale: To enable efficient manufacturing and assembly of new components.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SA14 line modified, Magi ink cart and labelling tool added in Orcus 5, and all components assembled as specified.

requirements.Title: Mold for 1 to 4 New Keyed Caps
requirements.Description: Create molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps to support new bottle designs.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure compatibility with new bottle types and enhance spill-free reliability.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Molds for 1 to 4 new keyed caps are produced and validated for bottle compatibility.

requirements.Title: Leverage Watt LE / Marconi Hi Mech + CISS
requirements.Description: The printer must leverage Watt LE and Marconi Hi mechanical platforms and integrate CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System).
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development costs, improve reliability, and support CISS market growth.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Watt LE, Marconi Hi, and CISS are integrated and operational in the Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20ppm (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: The printer must achieve print speeds of 25ppm for standard and 20ppm for color, with PDL (Page Description Language) speeds of 25/19ppm.
requirements.Rationale: To meet customer expectations for productivity and throughput.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standard and PDL modes.

requirements.Title: Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Support customer replaceable Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F to enable easy maintenance and reduce service calls.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce maintenance costs.
requirements.Dependencies: PHA and NOA-F design, user instructions
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Customers can replace PHA and NOA-F without technical assistance, following provided instructions.

requirements.Title: New Warranty Page Life Goal of 80k Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To increase product longevity and reduce warranty claims.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Warranty Teams, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Print engine durability, ink system reliability
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer maintains performance and reliability for at least 80,000 pages under warranty conditions.

requirements.Title: SKU 2 (Hi + Hi PDL) PaaS Offering
requirements.Description: Provide SKU 2 (High + High PDL) as a Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) offering for flexible business models.
requirements.Rationale: To support new business models and expand market reach.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SKU 2 is available as a PaaS offering and meets defined business requirements.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Size Increase for Tank
requirements.Description: The printer must use Reddington industrial design (ID) with an increased tank size. No change to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: To support higher ink capacity and maintain design consistency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Reddington ID implemented, tank size increased, and ADF remains unchanged.

requirements.Title: EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: The printer must use EPS foam packaging for protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure safe delivery and reduce damage during transport.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: EPS foam packaging is used, and printer arrives undamaged in standard shipping tests.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3 and LOT4 Requirement, Blue Angel for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: The printer must meet EPEAT3 and LOT4 environmental requirements, and Blue Angel certification for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: To comply with environmental standards and support eco-friendly product positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is certified for EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU.

requirements.Title: Input Tray and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to align with tank protrusion and optimize printer size.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure compatibility with increased tank size and maintain operational efficiency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Input and output trays are modified and tested for compatibility with tank protrusion.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization
requirements.Description: Optimize printer size to accommodate new tank design and maintain compact form factor.
requirements.Rationale: To improve space efficiency and meet customer expectations for printer size.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer size is optimized and meets defined dimensional targets.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display
requirements.Description: The printer must feature a 4.3-inch CGD (Color Graphic Display) for enhanced user interface.
requirements.Rationale: To improve usability and provide a modern user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is integrated and fully functional in the printer.

requirements.Title: Platform 4 Tubes – Sayan Sibstar Tubes
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for ink delivery.
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink flow reliability and support new tank configurations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Sayan Sibstar tubes are routed and integrated successfully in the platform.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management with Spit Platform Changes
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station with spit platform changes due to the new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce ink waste and improve maintenance efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Service station design, spit platform modifications
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol management system is implemented and reduces ink waste as measured in service tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model with Tube and New Weights
requirements.Description: Develop carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure smooth operation and prevent mechanical failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage dynamic and force models are validated and meet operational requirements.

requirements.Title: Paperpath to Support Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Modify paperpath design to support increased page life (80k pages).
requirements.Rationale: To ensure durability and reliability over extended usage.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paperpath is validated for 80,000 pages of reliable operation.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Service Center) – Post 80k Life
requirements.Description: Provide ink maintenance as a serviceable part for service centers after 80,000 page life.
requirements.Rationale: To support extended product life and facilitate maintenance post-warranty.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink maintenance part design, service center processes
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance part is available and serviceable post-80k page life.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, Keyed Bottles, Magi and Nessie Pigment Inks
requirements.Description: The printer must support SuperAmp PHA, NOA-F, keyed bottles, and Magi and Nessie pigment inks, with 140ml K bottles and new CMY bottle sizes.
requirements.Rationale: To provide high-capacity ink options and maintain compatibility with proven ink technologies.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports specified ink components and bottle sizes.

requirements.Title: IDS New Make-break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and FI (Fluidic Interface) connection for IDS (Ink Delivery System).
requirements.Rationale: To improve reliability and ease of maintenance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS make-break and FI connection are implemented and validated for reliability.

requirements.Title: LEBI Ink-tank with Increased Size, Keying and LOI SHAID
requirements.Description: Leverage LEBI ink-tank with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID (Logical One Ink Security and Authentication ID).
requirements.Rationale: To improve ink security, capacity, and compatibility.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: LEBI ink-tank is implemented with increased size, keying, and LOI SHAID.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS startup algorithm and air management system.
requirements.Rationale: To improve startup reliability and prevent air-related failures.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS startup algorithm and air management system are implemented and validated for reliable startup.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Hi PDL (Page Description Language) for compatibility and reduced development effort.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven technology and maintain compatibility with existing solutions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Marconi Hi PDL is integrated and fully functional in the Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: New Servicing and Startup Algorithm
requirements.Description: Develop new servicing and startup algorithm for improved maintenance and operational efficiency.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce downtime and improve user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Servicing and startup algorithm is implemented and validated for improved efficiency.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion to Meet Page Yield Definition
requirements.Description: Set new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion metrics to meet defined page yield requirements.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure consistent performance and customer satisfaction.
requirements.Dependencies: PQ goal definition, depletion metric development
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ goals and depletion metrics are defined, implemented, and validated against page yield targets.

requirements.Title: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Reuse Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU for hardware compatibility and reduced development costs.
requirements.Rationale: To leverage proven hardware and reduce time-to-market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Specified hardware components are integrated and validated in the Magellan printer.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-fi Module
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-fi module for wireless connectivity.
requirements.Rationale: To provide modern wireless features and improve user experience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Stingray Wi-fi module is integrated and provides reliable wireless connectivity.

requirements.Title: FW Dune
requirements.Description: Implement FW Dune firmware for operational compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure firmware reliability and compatibility with new hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: FW Dune is implemented and validated for operational reliability.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Integrate Gauss4.xx security features in hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: To provide enhanced security and protect against vulnerabilities.
requirements.Dependencies: Security feature integration, hardware and firmware compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Gauss4.xx security features are implemented and validated in hardware and firmware.

requirements.Title: Business Model: Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Support business models for Consumer, SMB (Small and Medium Business), and Enterprise segments.
requirements.Rationale: To expand market reach and address diverse customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and solutions are available for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments.

requirements.Title: Services: PaaS, WorkFromHome/Flexworker
requirements.Description: Provide services such as Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) and WorkFromHome/Flexworker solutions.
requirements.Rationale: To address changing work environments and offer flexible service options.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business Development, Product Management, Service Teams
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS and WorkFromHome/Flexworker services are available and meet defined requirements.

requirements.Title: Onboarding/S&O Path: Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP
requirements.Description: Support onboarding and S&O (Services and Operations) paths for Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: To streamline onboarding and improve customer experience across segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: Service Teams, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Onboarding paths are available and functional for all specified segments.

requirements.Title: Scan Solution
requirements.Description: Provide scan solution as part of the printer offering.
requirements.Rationale: To meet customer expectations for multifunction devices.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Scan solution is integrated and fully functional in the printer.

requirements.Title: SMB Manageability
requirements.Description: Provide manageability features for SMB customers.
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB segment needs for device management and control.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB manageability features are available and meet defined requirements.

requirements.Title: Enterprise Support: WJA, HPSM, JAM
requirements.Description: Support enterprise solutions including WJA (Web JetAdmin), HPSM (HP Smart Manage), and JAM (JetAdmin Management).
requirements.Rationale: To enable enterprise-level device management and support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Enterprise solutions are integrated and functional in the printer.

requirements.Title: Clients & Drivers: HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, UFD
requirements.Description: Support clients and drivers including HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD for broad compatibility.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure compatibility with various platforms and ease of installation.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT Teams, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All specified clients and drivers are supported and functional with the printer.

requirements.Title: Protect Micro/SMB Segments and Safeguard HP Profit Pool
requirements.Description: Protect Micro and SMB segments and safeguard HP’s traditional ink/laser profit pool from competitors.
requirements.Rationale: To maintain market share and profitability in key segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer features and business models are implemented to protect Micro/SMB segments and profit pool.

requirements.Title: Lead with LaserJet and Flank with PDL in Medium and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in Medium and Enterprise segments to win over competitors such as Epson as CISS grows.
requirements.Rationale: To strengthen HP’s market position and address competitive threats.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer is positioned and marketed to lead with LaserJet and flank with PDL in specified segments.

requirements.Title: Grow CISS Profitable Share by Playing in New Segments
requirements.Description: Expand CISS (Continuous Ink Supply System) profitable share by entering new segments.
requirements.Rationale: To increase revenue and market share through innovation and segment expansion.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS is integrated and printer is marketed in new segments for profitable share growth.

requirements.Title: Highly Leverage Watt-LE Mech Platform, Marconi-Hi Product (Reddington ID) and Solutions
requirements.Description: Leverage Watt-LE mechanical platform, Marconi-Hi product (Reddington ID), and solutions for development.
requirements.Rationale: To reduce development costs, improve reliability, and accelerate time-to-market.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Watt-LE, Marconi-Hi, and solutions are integrated and operational in the printer.

requirements.Title: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F and Ink Tanks
requirements.Description: Integrate CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks for improved ink delivery and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: To support CISS growth and enhance printer reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: CISS IDS integration, NOA-F design, ink tank compatibility
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: CISS IDS, NOA-F, and ink tanks are integrated and validated for reliable operation.

requirements.Title: New NGB Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Support new NGB keyed ink bottles for improved user experience and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: To enable spill-free operation and compatibility with new bottle designs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports new NGB keyed ink bottles and achieves spill-free operation.

requirements.Title: Schedule Constraints
requirements.Description: Adhere to defined schedule constraints for product development and launch.
requirements.Rationale: To ensure timely market entry and meet business objectives.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All development and launch activities are completed within defined schedule constraints.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K
requirements.Description: SuperAmp PHA must achieve a life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: To provide reliable printhead performance and reduce maintenance frequency.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA is validated for 65,000 pages of reliable operation.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of Pages, 2 Years
requirements.Description: Printer must support warranty life of pages for 2 years.
requirements.Rationale: To provide customer assurance and reduce warranty claims.
requirements.Stakeholders: Product Management, Warranty Teams, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Print engine durability, ink system reliability
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer maintains performance and reliability for defined page count over 2-year warranty period.

requirements.Title: Throughput 25/20 (PDL)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve throughput of 25/20 pages per minute in PDL mode.
requirements.Rationale: To meet productivity requirements for target segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified throughput in PDL mode.

requirements.Title: Serviceability (Maintenance Box)
requirements.Description: Provide serviceability features such as maintenance box for easy upkeep.
requirements.Rationale: To improve maintenance efficiency and reduce downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Maintenance box design, service process integration
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box is available and enables easy servicing of the printer.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution
requirements.Description: Provide SMB-focused solution for device manageability and support.
requirements.Rationale: To address SMB segment needs and improve device management.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SMB solution is available and meets defined requirements.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Schedule)
requirements.Description: Provide Platform-as-a-Service (PaaS) offering according to defined schedule.
requirements.Rationale: To enable flexible business models and timely market entry.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS offering is available according to defined schedule.

requirements.Title: Host 12K-CMYK
requirements.Description: Provide hosting for 12K-CMYK ink configuration.
requirements.Rationale: To support high-volume printing and expand ink options.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports 12K-CMYK ink configuration and achieves defined performance.

requirements.Title: Trade Page 6K
requirements.Description: Enable trade page configuration for 6K page yield.
requirements.Rationale: To support market flexibility and meet diverse customer needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Page yield configuration, ink system design
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer supports trade page configuration for 6K page yield.
